name: your-name
description: Your Name / Makoto Shinkai: deep saturated blue skies, bright lifted shadows, clean airy light.
notes: From Aizer's guide to anime-style Lightroom presets (Shinkai style). The guide gives most sliders as ranges; this uses the middle of each range. Its Light Blue band says only 'like Blue, a little less saturated', so Aqua follows Blue at lower saturation. Best on daytime skies, clouds and city or countryside views that aren't underexposed.
author: Aizer
